scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering expresses the verse's shared invitation to joyful singing and praise. Firm limestone beneath the worshippers indirectly echoes the LORD's title, the Rock of our salvation; the stone is ordinary landscape, not an object of worship. The people, clothing, and setting are artistic conventions, not a recorded event. God is not depicted.
